hook: A *free* AI crash course with *Google and TikTok* in the room.
dek: Bluehost's ELEVATE summit streams free Tuesday, November 10, with a New York watch party. Here is how to get the most out of it.

slides.label: What it is
slides.text: *ELEVATE*, a free small-business growth summit from *Bluehost*. Streams *Tuesday, November 10, noon to 6 p.m. ET*.

slides.label: In person
slides.text: Watch parties for the final stretch in *New York City*, San Francisco and Austin.

slides.label: Who is speaking
slides.text: Leaders from *Google* and *TikTok*, Bluehost parent *Newfold Digital* and *Codie Sanchez* of Contrarian Thinking.

slides.label: What it covers
slides.text: Using AI to get found, getting your business *recommended by AI chatbots*, AI agents for routine work and *selling on TikTok*.

slides.label: Show up with a plan
slides.text: Pick *one problem* before you log on. Take the *free tactics*, skip the upsells. Go to the *NYC watch party* if you can.

slides.label: The Den's take
slides.text: AI will not replace hustle. Used right, it *buys back the hours*.

question: What is the one task you would hand to AI tomorrow?
yt_title: Free AI Crash Course for Small Business Owners: Bluehost ELEVATE
caption_instagram:
Free AI course for small business owners: Bluehost's ELEVATE summit streams Tuesday, November 10, noon to 6 p.m. ET, with leaders from Google and TikTok. 💡

It covers using AI to get found online, getting your business recommended when people ask AI chatbots for suggestions, AI agents for routine tasks and driving demand on TikTok. There is an in-person watch party in New York City for the final stretch.

How to get value from it: pick one problem before you log on, write down the free tactics and skip the upsells, and go to the watch party if you can. The person next to you might be your next customer.
